This underexplored problem poses new challenges at the pre-writing stage, including how to research the topic and prepare an outline prior to writing. title: STORM: Building Wikipedia-Style Reports Through Simulated Expert ...
snippet: STORM, developed by Stanford's Oval lab and published at NAACL 2024, tackles this by breaking knowledge curation into stages that mirror human research workflows. Instead of generating articles directly, it first conducts research through simulated conversations between a Wikipedia writer persona and topic experts, grounded in web search results.
